questions.stem: A 30-year-old female patient comes to OPD with a complaint of increasing muscle weakness and fatigue during the day, requiring her to take frequent rests. She also reports that she cannot enjoy her meals anymore because while chewing her muscles feel fatigued and she has to stop chewing. When she watches television at night sometimes, her vision becomes blurry and she sees double. Her neurologist makes a preliminary diagnosis of myasthenia gravis. Which of the following is the cause of myasthenia gravis?

options.label: A
options.text: Acetylcholine synthesis in motor neurons is impaired.

options.label: C
options.text: Autoantibodies destroy cholinergic receptors at the postsynaptic membrane preventing the binding of acetylcholine.

options.label: D
options.text: Neurotransmitter release is impaired at the presynaptic membrane of the neuromuscular junction.
